The mapped public launch now runs an input-driven paddling course with visible oars/paddle, progress, no idle award and restoration to the same shore pose after cancellation. Shared sky-only water reflections replace the false reflected lighting boxes.
The course avoids the swimming enclosure, crescent pier and full visible moored hull OBBs; every existing boat remains rendered and collision-bearing.
remainingGaps: Kayaking still follows an automatic camera loop and lacks the required input-driven paddling and complete cancellation contract.
The May 15–September 30 rental dates are unverified and must not be presented as confirmed operating dates.
Stone skipping still produces a message without a visible stone trajectory or player challenge.
Pier rail/deck joins, pavilion details, hillside buildings and boathouse placement need matched official/aerial comparisons; remaining pier z-fighting needs physical repair.
Raw audit findings remain for physical review: zfight 28.
